title: Home Mortgage Loans: forbearance plan length limits and eligible hardships by program
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: forbearance plan length limits and eligible hardships by program

This document gives, for each Home Mortgage Loans program, the longest first forbearance plan, the longest total forbearance over the life of the loan, and the hardship types that are eligible for forbearance.

## Limits by program

| Program | Longest first plan (months) | Longest total forbearance over the life of the loan (months) | Eligible hardship types |
|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 6 | 12 | Involuntary job loss; medical; natural disaster; death of a co-borrower; military deployment |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 6 | 12 | Involuntary job loss; medical; natural disaster; death of a co-borrower; military deployment |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 3 | 12 | Involuntary job loss; medical; natural disaster; death of a co-borrower; military deployment |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 3 | 12 | Involuntary job loss; medical; natural disaster; death of a co-borrower; military deployment |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 3 | 12 | Involuntary job loss; medical; natural disaster; death of a co-borrower; military deployment |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 3 | 6 | Involuntary job loss; medical; natural disaster; death of a co-borrower |

## Hardship matrix

| Hardship type | FHA 30-Year | VA 30-Year | Conventional 30-Year | Conventional 15-Year | 7/6 SOFR ARM | Jumbo 30-Year |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Involuntary job loss | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible |
| Medical | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible |
| Natural disaster | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible |
| Death of a co-borrower | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible |
| Military deployment | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible | Eligible | Not listed |

## Points of judgement

- **Military deployment and the Jumbo program.** Military deployment is in the eligible list of five programs but is not in the Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage list.
- **First plan versus total.** The FHA and VA programs allow a first plan of up to 6 months, twice the 3 months of the other four programs, while the Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage has the lowest lifetime total, 6 months.
- **Hypothetical case.** A VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage loan whose first plan ran the full 6 months has used half of that program's 12-month lifetime total.
